note: Career runs. Endpoints are hand-picked terminal points — see docs/superpowers/specs/2026-08-22-run-criteria.md. A run is start, optional checkpoints, finish; a circuit is a run whose finish is its start. Ordered checkpoints let the author control the route shape; unordered ones hand the player a sequencing problem.

runs.name: The Grand Tour
runs.note: Checkpoints are pass-through, not stops: you must drive through the point, the clock never pauses. The whole cost of a checkpoint is entering and leaving the city at whatever hour your ordering puts you there.
tests: sequencing across a continent, not a perimeter — no obvious order
checkpoints INSIDE cities, so urban penetration is unavoidable
order determines arrival hour, arrival hour determines cost
